messages:
jenna: Quick sync — Splunk HEC ingest for Redwood Private (on-prem/VPC) — partner wants joint launch. Who owns the telemetry schema + PII gating? Need runbook + announcement checklist. (1755556789)

mike_s: I'll take the schema mapping. Do we want model traces in APM or index them as events?

selena_r: Prefer to send traces via OTLP -> Splunk OTEL Collector -> HEC. That keeps traces as traces and logs as events. We need a minimal envelope for model_id, shard, req_id, step.

ton y_p: Partner ask: sample dashboards + role-based saved searches. Splunk can provide app package. Partner-eng to get sample queries.

splunk_greg: Hey team! We can provide an App + dashboards. Sample link: https://docs.splunk.com/reds/integrations/redwood-sample (staged). Proposed timeline: alpha ingestion by 4/10, public docs 4/24. We can share HEC cert + sample events.

jenna: Great. Mike, can you add the trace fields to the runtime trace exporter? Selena - add ingest throttling and PII scrubber before HEC. Tony - coordinate partner app reviews.

mike_s: Will add fields. Quick config snippet:

``nexporter:
  splunk_hec:
    token: ${SPLUNK_HEC_TOKEN}
    endpoint: https://ingest.splunk.example:8088
    use_tls: true
    add_attributes: [model_id, model_version, shard, request_id]
```

mike_s: Also will add a canary flag to toggle envelope for Private customers.

selena_r: For PII scrubber: keep only hashed user_id, drop raw prompts unless opt-in. I'll draft scrub rules and small perf test.

ton y_p: Partner-eng: what's the approval process for listing the Splunk App in our Private Marketplace? Also need legal review for joint announcement.

splunk_greg: We'll send App package by EOD tomorrow. Legal has a template for co-announcements; I'll ping our legal. Also we support SAML SSO for dashboard sharing.

jenna: Checklist so far:
- schema mapping (mike)
- scrub rules + perf (selena)
- partner app review (tony)
- marketplace package + legal (splunk_greg + jenna)
- rollout plan: canary then 2-week ramp (mike)

jenna: Can everyone confirm status updates by EOD Friday? :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CI pipeline for `splunk-hec-integration` succeeded — build 138 ✅

mike_s: Confirmed. Will open PR today and tag for review.

selena_r: Confirmed. Perf test scheduled for Thu AM.

ton y_p: Confirmed. Booked partner review slot Fri 10am PT.

splunk_greg: Confirmed on our side. Thanks!

jenna: Thanks team — I'll assemble the announcement checklist once PRs merge. :rocket:
